panels.description: HIMALAYAS, 2042 — NIGHT. Roman hangs half-buried in a blue-white crevasse while his small silver Terrain Jumper descends on articulated legs. Lightning disrupts the machine's sensor housing. No glowing neural connection. Leave upper-left sky clear.

HIMALAYAS, 2026 — DAY. Seen from behind six-year-old Sitara on a high stone step, floodwater carries a cooking pot and a child's red sweater past her while an indistinct adult hand pulls her away. Keep faces and cultural details nonspecific. Leave upper-right clear.

ANTARCTICA, 2046 — DAY. Vast blue-white ice, distant ridges, warning flags, a dark unstable zone, and a half-buried sensor tripod. Sitara stands lower right beside her separate small silver field TJ; Nayah stands behind and left holding the route line. Leave upper-left snowfield clear.

Sitara's insulated boot hovers just short of the flagged line. The sensor's red status light blinks beyond it while a geometric tremor advances beneath translucent blue ice. Leave upper-left for dialogue and upper-right for the sound effect.
